summary: SANGRIX INC., a Singapore-domiciled Nasdaq foreign private issuer formerly known as Bit Origin Ltd, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 16, 2026, updating the delivery schedule for its 128-GPU NVIDIA Blackwell B300 project in Malaysia. The equipment seller, PT MITRA MANUNGGAL SANGKARA, relayed a manufacturer update indicating the 16 B300 servers are scheduled for delivery during the week of November 3, 2026, with roughly one additional week for inspection, racking and testing before commercial operations. The roughly US$11 million acquisition was originally announced June 29, 2026, updating a prior third-quarter 2026 delivery expectation. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price per share or change-of-control terms are stated; this is a routine operational update, not a special situation. Watch delivery slippage and commissioning risk as the arbitrage-relevant execution markers.
